audit.why: Ornn's magic damage ignores the one stat Malphite builds, but Unstoppable Force still owns a whole stage of the lane.
audit.corrected: diff kept; phase text now names what each side actually holds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 4 and 5 read Skill, Skill, Ornn.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Skill, Malphite, Skill, Ornn and mirror malphite__ornn states exactly that sequence. The page's own whys[4] calls his R the guaranteed all-in and whys[5] calls first item 'a coin flip' — both layers disagreed with their own text.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Ornn, row 4 to Malphite, row 5 to Skill, in matched full/content pairs; ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ground Slam is attributed to Malphite's Q, the attack-speed cut is called a 'W shred', and no cooldown appears anywhere.
audit.why: Ground Slam is E: 7s flat, 400 range, damage scaled off his armour, and it is the ability that reduces your attack speed. Thunderclap is W, 10s at rank 1, an auto-attack empowerment. Seismic Shard is Q, 8s flat at 625 range, and steals move speed for 3s. Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1 and 1000 range. Granite Shield absorbs only 10% of his max health and recharges if he goes a few seconds unhit — chip it before committing.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected, the 7s / 8s / 10s / 130s numbers and the Granite Shield recharge rule written into phases, do/don'ts, cooldowns, mid and spikes[2].

edits.before: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite. Identify how Malphite contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite, and Granite Shield only holds 10% of his HP. Break it before you commit.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Malphite's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is 130s at 1000 range and knocks you up outright — his stage. Bait it, then punish more than two minutes of nothing.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Unstoppable Force's cooldown.
edits.after: Your tank item lands, but his 130s R can still flip any extended trade — a coin flip until it is spent.

edits.before: His engage. Brittle-tank when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 130s at rank 1 and 1000 range — once he spends it the lane is yours.

edits.before: That is Malphite's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Thunderclap is 10s of aftershock autos — step out and let the buff expire.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Granite Shield recharges if he goes unhit — chip it before you commit.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Ground Slam is 7s, cuts your attack speed, and scales off his armour — do not grind autos into it.

edits.before: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — His engage. Brittle-tank when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — 130s at rank 1, 1000 range; bait it and the lane is yours. - Ground Slam: 7s, scales off his armour and cuts your attack speed. - Granite Shield: 10% of his HP, recharges unhit.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Unstoppable Force: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade after Unstoppable Force's 130s is spent. Break Granite Shield first — it absorbs 10% of his HP and recharges the moment you stop hitting him.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are genuinely even: your E-Q pillar knock-up is lethal but his W shred and Q slow let him trade back, so it comes down to who lands their setup.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are genuinely even: your E-Q pillar knock-up is lethal, but Ground Slam's attack-speed cut and Seismic Shard's slow let him trade back.

edits.before: A Sunfire/Heartsteel and boots turn you into a durable W-poke bully who shrugs off his Q (Ground Slam-empowered) pokes.
edits.after: A Sunfire/Heartsteel and boots turn you into a durable W-poke bully who shrugs off Seismic Shard and Ground Slam chip.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are even — you both want to set up, and your E-into-Q-pillar knock-up is strong but his W shred and Q slow let him trade respectably, so it's a skill window. Then 6 belongs to him: his R (Unstoppable Force) is a long-range guaranteed knock-up that wins the flat all-in and sets up ganks before your team value comes online. Hold your E and don't get walled into his ult — bait the R, then punish the long cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are even — you both want to set up, and your E-into-Q-pillar knock-up is strong but Ground Slam's attack-speed cut and Seismic Shard's slow let him trade respectably, so it's a skill window. Then 6 belongs to him: his R (Unstoppable Force) is a 130s long-range guaranteed knock-up that wins the flat all-in and sets up ganks before your team value comes online. Hold your E and don't get walled into his ult — bait the R, then punish it.

notes: The packet's suspectName 'Your Unstoppable Force' is a false positive — correct name with a possessive in front. Ground Slam was attributed to Malphite's Q in spikes[2] and the attack-speed reduction was called a 'W shred' in whys[3] and mid; both are now on E where they belong. As on the rest of this champion's pages I did not restate the unsupported 'unstoppable / shield' claim for Bellows Breath, though whys[0] and spikes[0] here rest on the separate and correct point that Bellows Breath deals magic damage his armour cannot reduce.
